detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Scan dependency manifests (e.g., pom.xml, build.gradle) for references to Bouncy Castle versions known to be vulnerable. Use software composition analysis (SCA) tools to flag outdated or vulnerable components. Monitor application logs for cryptographic errors or unexpected decryption events. Alert on inclusion of any cryptographic library version with a public CVE rated critical or higher.
